annotations.title: Dutch house prices for a postcode (paid)

description: Netherlands house prices (huizenprijzen, WOZ-waarde) for any postcode or CBS buurt code: average home value (WOZ) in the neighbourhood with its trend, plus actual average sale prices per year in the municipality vs the national average. Property valuation context for real estate, mortgage, investment and relocation agents. Source: CBS, Kadaster. Costs 0.003 USDC via x402, or 2 credits of a Factline API key.

code.description: Alternative: CBS neighbourhood code, e.g. BU05182245

postcode.description: Any Dutch postcode in the neighbourhood, e.g. 2517AS
